title: Personal Checking: Monthly Maintenance Fee Assessment, Waivers and Paper Statement Charges
content:
## Assessment clause

When a statement cycle closes, a Personal Checking account is charged its tier's monthly maintenance fee as a single monthly maintenance fee entry, belonging to the cycle that is closing and dated on the cycle closing date — unless the account meets, for that cycle, at least one waiver its tier offers. The tier that counts is the one on the account when the cycle closes, and that tier's own fee and waiver levels apply.

## Waivers

Any single waiver the tier offers is enough on its own. Waivers never add up to a partial reduction, and the fee is never prorated. A waiver the tier marks as not offered is unavailable. The possible waivers are:

| Waiver | Met when |
|---|---|
| Lowest daily balance | the lowest end-of-day ledger balance on any calendar day of the cycle is at or above the tier's level |
| Direct deposits | ACH direct deposits posted during the cycle total at least the tier's level |
| Relationship balance | the relationship balance at cycle close is at or above the tier's level |
| Debit card purchases | the number of debit card purchases (domestic and international) posted during the cycle reaches the tier's count |
| Younger owner | the primary owner's age at cycle close is below the tier's figure |
| Older owner | when the cycle closes, the primary owner has reached the tier's figure or is older |
| Military | the customer profile shows active-duty military status at cycle close, on a tier where this waiver applies |
| Employee | the customer profile shows active PCB employee status at cycle close, on a tier where this waiver applies |

A cycle begins the day after the prior cycle closed and ends on its own closing date. The lowest daily balance is taken from the closing ledger balance of each calendar day in that span, built from every posted entry.

## When no maintenance fee arises

- An account's first statement cycle, the one in which it was opened, carries no maintenance fee.
- The fee applies only where the account record shows active or restricted status when the cycle closes.
- A dormant account is charged the dormant account fee in its place; the two are never both charged.
- An account carries no more than one monthly maintenance fee for any one statement cycle.

## Paper statement fee

Separately, when statements go out on paper as of cycle close, the tier's paper statement fee is charged for that cycle as a paper statement fee entry, unless the primary owner is at or above the tier's paper-fee exemption age at cycle close. A change of delivery method counts for the cycle in which it is recorded and is judged as that cycle closes.

## A maintenance fee charged despite a waiver

A monthly maintenance fee charged for a cycle in which a waiver was met is a bank error, and it is refunded.

## Hypothetical decision

Take a hypothetical tier whose waiver levels are a lowest daily balance of 1000.00 USD, direct deposits of 600.00 USD and eight debit card purchases. An account on it, active at cycle close, had a lowest daily balance of 900.00 USD, direct deposits of 620.00 USD and six purchases. The direct deposit waiver alone is met, so no maintenance fee is charged, even though the balance and purchase waivers are missed; had direct deposits been 590.00 USD, no waiver would be met and the full fee would be charged.
